newsitem.title: UK: S&P affirms CalEnergy, outlook stable.
newsitem.headline: S&P affirms CalEnergy, outlook stable.

text.p: Standard & Poor's said on Wednesday it affirmed the BB senior debt rating of CalEnergy Co and the B plus preferred stock rating of CalEnergy Capital Trust.

This followed the announcement last week of a proposal by CE Electric -- 70 percent CalEnergy and 30 percent Peter Kiewit Sons -- to acquire Northern Electric Plc, which is rated A, CreditWatch negative, Standard & Poor's said in a statement.

"The rating affirmations acknowledge that uncertainties exist concerning regulatory approvals and potential conditions associated with any such approval. However, the BB rating reflects these attendant effects of regulatory approval."
S&P said it expects CalEnergy will continue to experience success in completing its facilities currently under construction.

"Standard & Poor's further expects that equity distributions from these and existing facilities, including Northern, if the bid is successful, will continue to reduce the company's leveraged position and provide adequate debt servce coverages."

It said there was potential for ratings improvements if CalEnergy continued its capital underpinning program, if regulatory policies did not adversely reduce forecast cashflows to the parent, and if current parent liquidity and leverage improved.
